facts.business: Frontline Corporation Limited is engaged in transportation, wind energy, trading of automotive parts, petroleum distribution, and renting of immovable properties.

auditor.name: M/s. Paresh Thothawala & Co., Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (1) Non-provision of interest of Rs. 671.98 Lacs on NPA accounts leading to understated liabilities and overstated profit; (2) No impairment assessment on assets subject to lenders' possession/auction proceedings with stay orders, making carrying value uncertain; (3) Uncertain consequences preventing impact quantification. Emphasis of matter on SARFAESI notices, pending DRT/High Court/Supreme Court litigation, and Fairdeal Supplies Limited CIRP involving promoter-directors.

key_risks: Non-provision of interest on NPA accounts (Rs. 671.98 Lacs) understating liabilities and overstating profit
Assets subject to lenders' possession/auction proceedings with stay orders; no impairment assessment performed
Ongoing litigation with lenders under SARFAESI Act, DRT, High Court, and Supreme Court
Promoter-directors' involvement in Fairdeal Supplies Limited CIRP
High operational and administrative costs denting margins
Uncertain legal outcomes affecting financial statements
facts.related_party_note: Deposit of Rs. 81.09 Lacs outstanding from Directors as on 31st March 2026. Fairdeal Supplies Limited (promoter-directors are also directors/promoters) admitted to CIRP by NCLT Kolkata Bench.
